# Mardi Treks

Mardi Treks is a Nepal trekking and travel company. This file provides
machine-readable discovery links; current trip prices, dates, inclusions,
locations, and contact details are published on the linked website pages.

## Canonical Website
- Homepage: https://www.marditreks.com/
- Trek search: https://www.marditreks.com/search
- Blog: https://www.marditreks.com/blog
- About: https://www.marditreks.com/about
- Contact: https://www.marditreks.com/contact

## Machine-Readable Discovery
- Sitemap: https://www.marditreks.com/sitemap.xml
- Crawler policy: https://www.marditreks.com/robots.txt

## Content Types
- Trek and travel category pages
- Trek detail pages with itineraries, prices, route information, FAQs, and reviews
- Editorial trekking guides

## Usage Notes
- Treat each page's canonical URL as the authoritative URL.
- Prefer facts shown on the relevant trek page over summaries in this file.
- Check visible publication or update dates before citing time-sensitive facts.
